name: tailscale
description: Read or change your tailnet through the Tailscale API using the apiKey plugin option.

apiKey.title: Tailscale API key
apiKey.description: A tskey-api-... key. Sent only to api.tailscale.com in the Authorization header; leave it out of repository settings, which would make the plugin refuse it. OAuth secrets (tskey-client-...) are not supported.
